title: Splitting the circuit compression rate
statement: For natural numbers $w$, $\ell$, and $r$ with $1 \le r$, define $s(k)=1/(10k)$ for each natural number $k$, viewing $k$ as a real number, and define $C(a,b,q)=s(a)s(b)^q$. Then $s(w)C(\ell,\ell,r-1)=C(w,\ell,r)$.
